# Field boundaries for the Canadian Prairies, derived from Sentinel-2

Canada, Prairies field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from University of Saskatchewan. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/latest/ca_prairies.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: metrics:perimeter, admin:subdivision_code, admin_local_code, metrics:area, geometry, id, admin_local_name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/collection.json
